script_text: Stop, Pisces — Neptune just lit a fuse under your water-sign chart. Saturn is stationing at 2° Pisces in your 1st House, trining Jupiter in Cancer in your 5th House, so discipline and joy are demanding space. Mars at the end of Aries is conjunct Neptune in your 2nd House, making purchases, paychecks, and price negotiations emotionally charged. As a Neptune-ruled water sign, you can read the room, but this conjunction can blur receipts, deposits, and promises. In love, a 5th-House flirtation or creative date can turn serious if someone shows consistent effort, not just poetic words. If attached, avoid confusing guilt with devotion; your partner needs practical reassurance. Career and money: Mercury conjunct Jupiter in your 5th House trines your 10th House of reputation, so pitch one idea, invoice promptly, and ask for the fee you quoted. Avoid signing anything unread. Subscribe so you don't miss this week.
